description:
The dashboard 'Server Room Overview' is currently displaying data from decommissioned UPS sensors. You need to reconfigure the widgets to show the correct Server Room feeds.

Target Feeds:
- Power: 'server_power' (0-5000 W)
- Temperature: 'server_temp' (10-45 °C)
- Humidity: 'server_humidity' (%RH)

Task:
1. Open the 'Server Room Overview' dashboard.
2. Edit the dashboard to reconfigure the three widgets:
   - Change the Power Dial to use the 'server_power' feed. Set max value to 5000. Label: 'Server Power (W)'.
   - Change the Temperature Dial to use the 'server_temp' feed. Set min to 10, max to 45. Label: 'Temperature (°C)'.
   - Change the Humidity Value display to use the 'server_humidity' feed. Label: 'Humidity (%RH)'.
3. Save the dashboard.
